data.body:
Implemented and pushed for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1492

All three 300s network fetch sites now splice `git_fetch.stall_abort_args()` (reused, not copied):
- `review_bot/gerrit_client.clone_change_ref` — both fetches (change ref + tickets mirror);
- `opcert_service/workspace._git` — the module's only git seam, armed for `fetch` only (the options tune the curl transport; a local `config`/`worktree` call has none);
- `_commands/_init_probe.run_bounded_git` — init's `_git_fetch` builds its argv there. Armed for `fetch` only, which also leaves the 10s ls-remote probe (already tighter than any low-speed window) and its argv-shape test stubs untouched.

Two implementation notes worth keeping:
1. First attempt armed it inside `_commands/init.py`; CI's module-size gate failed the build at 809 LOC (cap 800, and init.py was already at 799). Moving the arming down to the `_init_probe` seam is both the better seam and keeps init.py untouched.
2. Arming `run_bounded_git` unconditionally broke `tests/integration/test_init_fail_closed.py`, whose fake `run_git_fn` dispatches on `args[0] == "ls-remote"`. Hence the fetch-only condition.

Tests: per site, a local fake remote in two modes — headers then zero bytes (must abort as a stall) and a continuous dribble above the floor (must NOT be aborted). The dribble case is the discriminator that fails any elapsed-time-keyed implementation. The fake remote moved to `tests/_stall_remote.py` so 12e4's tests and these share one copy.
